title: Sailing knots: six every crew member uses
h1: Six knots every crew member uses
lead: Six knots cover almost every job on a cruising yacht, from mooring to reefing. For each one: what it is for, how to tie it, how to check it and the mistake to avoid.
description: Six sailing knots every crew member needs: bowline, clove hitch, round turn and two half hitches, cleat hitch, figure-of-eight and reef knot, step by step.
summary: Bowline for a fixed loop; cleat hitch for making fast on a cleat.
Clove hitch for fenders; round turn and two half hitches for a loaded ring or post.
Figure-of-eight stoppers keep sheets from running out through blocks.
A reef knot is for reef points and sail ties only, never for joining loaded lines.
